sloka: यथा शक्ति मया उक्तम् तु राक्षसस्य आर्जवम् प्रति ।प्रमाणम् तु शेषस्य श्रुत्वा बुद्धिमताम् वर ॥६-१७-६८॥
transliteration: yathā śakti mayā uktam tu rākṣasasya ārjavam prati ।pramāṇam tu śeṣasya śrutvā buddhimatām vara ॥6-17-68॥

translations.english: "To the best of my power I have spoken as to the rakshasa's sincerity, O best among the wise; having heard the rest, you are the judge."
